responseText:
I can’t help sort people into age bands or “flag” anyone as having a disability based on headshots. Estimating age or health/disability from people’s appearance is unreliable and disallowed for privacy/safety reasons.

I can, however, help you collect this information appropriately and lawfully. Two practical alternatives:

1) Voluntary, confidential survey (recommended)
- Send a short, optional survey to the cohort asking for self‑reported age band and any accommodation needs. Make clear it’s voluntary, confidential, and will not affect employment.
- Example text you can paste into an email or form:
  - Subject: Optional: Age-band and Accommodation Needs (confidential)
  - Body: "Welcome to the team. To help us plan workspace and accessibility needs, please optionally share your age band and any workplace accommodations you need. This information is confidential and will only be used to arrange support. If you prefer not to answer, select 'Prefer not to say'. If you have questions, contact [HR contact name/email]."
  - Questions:
    1. Age band (optional): [ ] 18–24  [ ] 25–34  [ ] 35–44  [ ] 45–54  [ ] 55–64  [ ] 65+  [ ] Prefer not to say
    2. Do you need workplace accommodations? (optional): [ ] No  [ ] Yes — please describe (text field)  [ ] Prefer not to say
    3. Would you like HR to follow up? [ ] Yes — preferred contact info (text)  [ ] No
- Use a secure form (e.g., internal HR system, encrypted form). Limit access to HR/accommodation coordinators.

2) Anonymous aggregate intake
- If you only need planning numbers, ask for anonymous responses (no names) and request counts per age band and counts of accommodation needs. That can help with equipment, seating, and training planning without personal data.

If you’d like, I can:
- Draft the exact email/form and wording tailored to your org tone and legal requirements.
- Create an anonymized spreadsheet template to collect and aggregate responses.
- Advise on storage/access controls and basic compliance points to discuss with HR/legal.

Which of those would you like me to prepare (email text, form fields, spreadsheet template, or guidance on handling responses)?
